urn:csabs:concept/FiniteField.mapping: Mathlib Field A with an explicit Finite A witness, equality of elements, and unchanged exact operations. Catalog inverse/division restrict Mathlib total operations to nonzero inputs.
urn:csabs:concept/FiniteField.limitations: No chosen size, polynomial basis or encoding. No proof witnesses for the new finite-field classification or Frobenius results.

urn:csabs:concept/BTree.mapping: Raw RoseTree (List A): each node carries a finite key list and an ordered finite child list. Empty B-tree shape is RoseTree.node [] []. Structural equality preserves keys and child order.
urn:csabs:concept/BTree.limitations: Partial raw-shape interpretation only. Minimum degree, occupancy, arity, key ordering, balance, membership, height and updates are not formalized; no B-tree proof witnesses.

urn:csabs:concept/Lock.mapping: Finite-support P→Option M holder map, symmetric compatibility C and pairwise compatibility proof. Identity equality of holder maps; at most one mode per process. canAcquire and guarded acquires/releases correspond to the recorded atomic state steps.
urn:csabs:concept/Lock.limitations: No waiting queues, scheduling, Boolean decision wrappers, timeouts, memory visibility or implementation refinement. No compiled witnesses for the new graph claims.

urn:csabs:concept/Mutex.mapping: Option P with none unowned and some p owned. acquires/releases are guarded state relations; tryAcquire has exact non-spurious Boolean results. Equality is Option equality and process identity.
urn:csabs:concept/Mutex.limitations: No blocking-call histories, fairness, recursive acquisition, crash recovery or memory fences. No compiled witnesses for the new graph claims.

urn:csabs:concept/LamportBakery.mapping: Raw state for Fin n processes: choosing flags, unbounded Nat tickets, and uninterpreted natural program counters, scan indices and per-process local read data.
urn:csabs:concept/LamportBakery.limitations: No legal control-state invariant, SC transition relation, reachability, protocol refinement, fairness, mutual-exclusion proof or failure/weak-memory model. This binding supplies raw state fields only.

urn:csabs:concept/ObjectHeap.mapping: HeapStore instantiated with class tags and finite qualified-field maps; primitive/reference sum, null Option, partial field access/update, identity and allocated aliasing are explicit.
urn:csabs:concept/ObjectHeap.limitations: Inherited raw heap operations remain available. No typing, encapsulation, lifetime, GC, concurrency or implementation refinement is established.

urn:csabs:concept/ClassTable.mapping: Classes are Fin(n+1); parent/root, finite local declarations and a decreasing auxiliary rank certify the single-inheritance profile. Ancestor/lookup traversal uses n+1 fuel; dispatch reads the heap class tag. Erase rank evidence for extensional table equality.
urn:csabs:concept/ClassTable.limitations: Lookup and ancestors are implemented, but the general proof that n+1 fuel suffices and correspondence with the recursive graph equations is not registered. Bodies are opaque; type safety and behavioral compatibility are absent.

urn:csabs:concept/MethodContract.mapping: Pre/post/writable predicates over fixed-domain total stores; trace after-state, outcome and all writes; allows, satisfies and covered match the selected relational profile. Instantiate Outcome with Sum Result Exception.
urn:csabs:concept/MethodContract.limitations: Allocation, faults outside the outcome carrier, execution instrumentation correctness and termination are not modeled. Preconditions may be empty and coverage is separate.

urn:csabs:concept/ObjectInvariant.mapping: Whole-object-heap predicate, allocated receiver, constructor poststates and receiver-preserving boundary relation. Establishment and preservation are explicit structure hypotheses; reachable uses finite reflexive-transitive closure.
urn:csabs:concept/ObjectInvariant.limitations: Boundary completeness is a client obligation: callbacks and alias interference must be included. No compiled reachable-valid witness or hidden-instruction, liveness or concurrency claim is registered.

urn:csabs:concept/BehavioralSubtyping.mapping: Explicit legal-state, method-coverage, pre/post and history-constraint implications under an abstraction function and method map. urn:csabs:concept/BehavioralSubtyping.limitations: The semantic implications are modeled, but connection of historyPair to actual executions, general signature adapters, full trace/contextual substitutability and total correctness remain obligations. No nominal inheritance implication or subtype theorem is asserted.

urn:csabs:concept/HeapSeparation.mapping: Extensional HeapStore(V) predicates; disjoint domains, relational graph of partial merge, exact emp/singleton and existential star splitting. Model equality of predicates by pointwise logical equivalence.
urn:csabs:concept/HeapSeparation.limitations: Selected mathematical interface, with merge given relationally. No general frame rule, local operational semantics, fractional permissions, concurrent rule or automatically proved separation laws is registered.

urn:csabs:concept/TemplateMetafunction.mapping: Kind-correct List Arg to Option Result in a fixed environment; TemplateArgument supplies disjoint type/value/template tags; partial composition is explicit. Instantiate carriers with canonical argument identities and result observations.
urn:csabs:concept/TemplateMetafunction.limitations: The function is a mathematical interpretation, not a decision procedure for compilation, equivalence, instantiation termination or compiler limits. Apply only after target-environment and canonical-argument mapping.

urn:csabs:concept/TemplateSpecialization.mapping: Finite matching set, explicit irreflexive/transitive more-specialized relation, winner predicate and Primary/Chosen/Ambiguous selection.
urn:csabs:concept/TemplateSpecialization.limitations: Deduction, associated constraints, standard C++ partial ordering and visibility are supplied adapters, not inferred from match-set inclusion. No general compiler or chosen-body correctness theorem is registered.

urn:csabs:concept/TemplateSubstitution.mapping: Ordered Continue/ImmediateInvalid/RequiredHardError events with a stopping scan; a supplied frontend connects environment, substitution and syntax to events and a successful artifact.
urn:csabs:concept/TemplateSubstitution.limitations: Actual syntactic substitution, lexical event generation, access checking and immediate-context/side-effect classification remain frontend obligations. IFNDR cases are excluded. No complete C++ deduction algorithm or SFINAE theorem is registered.

urn:csabs:concept/TemplateConstraint.mapping: Atom/conjunction/disjunction trees, three-way short-circuit satisfaction, DNF/CNF clauses and identity-based subsumption. Atom equality must encode resolved source-expression origin and parameter mappings.
urn:csabs:concept/TemplateConstraint.limitations: Actual C++ normalization, argument substitution, atomic equivalence and constant-expression checking remain adapters. Invalid normalization/IFNDR and later-standard fold-expanded subsumption are outside the profile.

urn:csabs:concept/TemplateParameterPack.mapping: List of canonical same-kind arguments; map expansion, length-checked zip expansion and explicit left/right binary fold trees.
